decisions.decision: Preserve the incompatible active native Goal and continue the full parent objective in this live ledger.
decisions.effect: No native goal replacement and no false completion.

decisions.decision: Treat the historical solver symptom as numerical floating-point stagnation, not convergence or physical infeasibility.
decisions.basis: Read-only recheck exit 0; unchanged objective and projected gradient; only one tiny pressure component changed.

decisions.decision: W01 may change only bound-active-set and line-search progress classification in scaled coordinates.
invariants: all residual blocks and unknowns remain
strict representable objective decrease is required for acceptance

decisions.decision: Heavy Julia and DESC runs are owned and serialized by sol_main.
Use a versioned additive spatial loader with explicit invokelatest boundary and fail-closed duplicate or partial-load state.
decisions.basis: The first full rerun failed after 528.65 seconds at the dynamic Julia world-age boundary; a focused reproduction now passes.

decisions.decision: Do not silently correct reference metadata or grant inverse readiness without raw data and unit consistency.
decisions.basis: FAIR MAST metadata reports an electron-density signal unit inconsistent with the expected physical dimension; raw data remain pending.

decisions.decision: Classify W01 as a numerical stagnation repair but not a physics convergence repair.
decisions.basis: All 40 production updates across four cases have strict representable objective decrease, while every case exits 4 at its iteration limit and remains above residual tolerance.

decisions.decision: Keep credible candidate count at zero and final authority deferred.
decisions.basis: Runner exit 0 and 43/43 integration checks establish execution integrity only; physics status is fail and physical validation is unsupported.

decisions.decision: Interpret the original manufactured-recovery failures for perturbation 3 as an iteration-budget mechanism, not divergence.
decisions.basis: Preregistered 24/48-update extensions produced identical convergence at update 13 on h033 and update 21 on h025, with strict objective decrease at every accepted update.

decisions.decision: Accept N1 recovery robustness but reject a claim of verified grid convergence or discretization order.
decisions.basis: The preregistered 3-resolution by 3-perturbation family converged 9/9 with strict accepted updates, but perturbation 1 error increased from 6.9456e-5 at h=0.25 to 2.74459e-4 at h=0.2, yielding observed order -6.15795.

decisions.decision: Do not upgrade R03, physical validation, platform readiness, or candidate credibility from the N1 benchmark.
decisions.basis: N1 is manufactured and numerical-only with evidence authority none; the real spatial chain remains nonconverged and whole-device authority remains deferred.

decisions.decision: Use the official DESC v0.17.3 packaged HELIOTRON equilibrium as the first source-complete N2 external-simulation input.
decisions.basis: Its frozen HDF5 contains fixed-boundary geometry, toroidal flux, pressure and exactly one iota profile; the official-release download hash matches the installed desc-opt 0.17.3 copy.

decisions.decision: Keep HELIOTRON authority at external-simulation input only and exclude display labels from the normalized physics subject hash.
decisions.basis: The artifact was generated by the same DESC code family, is not measurement data, has no independent solver comparison, and provides no calibration or held-out split.

decisions.decision: Do not treat successful normalization as RuntimeV4 integration or inverse recovery.
decisions.basis: The next required slice must bind the normalized subject to typed G2, freshly reexecute DESC, and independently map the same subject into the spatial residual before any code-to-code comparison; genuine inverse and held-out prediction remain separate.

decisions.decision: Supersede the r1 normalized subject for trusted typed binding because its provenance was incomplete.
decisions.basis: The container holds four equilibria and r1 omitted selected member index 3; the HDF5 embeds 0.17.1+38.g53ea59ef0.dirty while r1 conflated distribution tag and loader runtime 0.17.3 with producer identity.

decisions.decision: Bind the corrected r2 source only as an external-simulation boundary/profile input with screen-only authority.
decisions.basis: The binding checks exact source/result bytes, declared subject hash, provenance, truncation bounds, Fourier modes, profiles, flux and current candidate membership; it selects no provider and emits no evidence.

decisions.decision: Do not replace the source Fourier-Zernike interior with a guessed radial law, flip Fourier signs, reduce source resolution or widen provider domains to force HELIOTRON execution.
decisions.basis: The HDF5 owns a full multi-radial-order Fourier-Zernike equilibrium but r2 does not normalize it and the current interpreter is single-power-per-boundary-mode; NFP 19 is outside its 2..8 domain, stored base-mode signs fail its analytic proof, and source L=24 exceeds the fixed-boundary declaration cap 12.

decisions.decision: Keep every final requirement unaccepted and credible candidate count at zero.
decisions.basis: The new slice establishes exact typed representation only; genuine inverse recovery, held-out prediction, provider execution, independent spatial comparison, physical validation and whole-device net output remain absent.

decisions.decision: Supersede r2 as a trusted Julia binding input after independent review found a P1 caller-supplied subject/hash gap.
decisions.basis: The r2 binder checked file bytes but did not parse the normalized result or recompute its declared subject hash; a caller could pair a valid result file hash with unrelated subject fields.

decisions.decision: Use r3 exact Python canonical subject wire as the cross-language hash ABI and require Julia to parse and rehash the result itself.
decisions.basis: Julia JSON3 floating-point serialization is not byte-equivalent to Python json.dumps; r3 emits the original canonical wire, Julia verifies wire SHA, structural subject equality, authority ceiling, typed projection and exact candidate field membership. Forged hash, altered subject and promoted authority tests pass fail-closed.

decisions.decision: Correct the source-interior gap: the HDF5 owns Fourier-Zernike interior coefficients but the r3 normalized subject and current single-power interpreter do not represent them.
decisions.basis: Member index 3 has 591 R and 578 Z coefficients above 1e-12, with multiple radial orders per (m,n); l is a Zernike radial degree, not rho^l. No equivalent typed evaluator or provider route was invented.

decisions.decision: Freeze the complete selected HDF5 Fourier-Zernike interior as a separate r4 representation artifact without claiming a typed evaluator or changing the r3 typed boundary/profile contract.
decisions.basis: All 598 R and 585 Z stored modes/coefficients, fringe indexing and cos/sin symmetry are source-owned and can be preserved exactly; member 2 has different coefficient arrays. The source radial degree is not an interchangeable power law.

decisions.decision: Accept only same-family scalar geometry-basis numerical reconstruction at five frozen points, not a physical or typed RuntimeV4 validation.
decisions.basis: A separate SciPy Jacobi/Fourier evaluator agrees with DESC selected-member basis evaluation within 1e-9 m at all five preregistered nodes, but it has no derivative proof, typed G2 coordinate/metric AST, independent equilibrium physics, or experimental evidence.
